name: OutboundCalls – AI Instant Callback
author: syntranova

sections.description:
Leads go cold in minutes. OutboundCalls calls them back right away with your AI voice agent, which qualifies the lead, answers questions and books a meeting.

  • “Call me now” form anywhere with the shortcode [outboundcalls_callback]
  • Contact Form 7: call every new lead automatically (optional)
  • Consent checkbox on the form, honeypot and rate limits to protect your call credits
  • Pick your voice agent from a list after connecting your account
  • Your API key stays on your server and is never shown to visitors

You need an OutboundCalls account with a voice agent, a phone number and call credits.

External services

This plugin connects to the OutboundCalls API (https://outboundcalls.ai/api/v1/) from your WordPress server, using the API key you enter:

  • In the settings page, it reads your account (GET /me) and your voice agents (GET /agents) to show them in a list.
  • When a visitor submits the “Call me now” form and ticks the consent box, or when a Contact Form 7 form is sent with this option switched on, it sends the phone number and the selected agent to OutboundCalls (POST /calls) so the AI agent calls that number. The visitor’s name is not sent.

Nothing is loaded from OutboundCalls in the visitor’s browser. The service is provided by Syntranova AL Ltd (OutboundCalls): Terms of service, Privacy policy.

You are responsible for having the caller’s consent and for following the calling rules of your country (for example GDPR in the EU, TCPA in the United States).
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New and activate it.
  2. Create an OutboundCalls account at https://outboundcalls.ai/, set up a voice agent and a phone number.
  3. In your OutboundCalls dashboard create an API key (Settings → API Keys).
  4. Go to Settings → OutboundCalls, paste the key, save, then choose the voice agent.
  5. Add [outboundcalls_callback] to any page, or switch on calls for Contact Form 7.
sections.faq:
How fast is the call?

The call starts as soon as the form is sent, usually within a few seconds.

Can someone abuse the form?

Each number can be called once every 10 minutes and each visitor can request 3 calls per hour. A hidden honeypot field stops simple bots.

Can I change the form texts?

Yes: [outboundcalls_callback title=”Talk to us in 30 seconds” button=”Call me”].
